Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 63
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Monday, Ashoj 12, 2083
1:30 PM
(Second Meeting)
Management Work
1. Honorable Minister for Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security, Sita Kumari, will present a proposal for consideration of the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws Relating to Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security, 2083".
2. Honorable Minister for Health and Food Hygiene, Nisha Mehta, will present proposals for consideration of:
  a) "Bill on Substitutes for Breast Milk (Control of Sale and Distribution) (First Amendment), 2083"
  b) "Bill on Safe Motherhood and Reproductive Health Rights (First Amendment), 2083"
  c) "Bill on Security of Health Workers and Health Institutions (Second Amendment), 2083"
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Management Work
sections.summary_en: The Minister for Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security presented a proposal for consideration of a bill to amend laws related to her ministry. The Minister for Health and Food Hygiene presented three separate proposals for consideration of bills related to maternal health, reproductive rights, and health worker security.
